scope.notes: Inventory in progress (229 rows). Covers Exalted: The Lunars core innate powers (Lunar Shapechanging, the Tell, True Forms, Caste Mark tattooing/Fixing the Caste, Casteless consequences), the full Shapechanging I/II/III Charm trees (with the Deadly Beastman Transformation gift table), the full Body Enhancement I/II Charm trees, the full Unarmed Combat I through V Charm trees plus three further Body Weapon Technique-rooted utility Charms -- completing the entire Unarmed Combat Charm category -- the complete Melee Combat I/II Charm trees (26 Charms), the complete Ranged Combat I/II Charm trees (17 Charms), pp. 149-161/PDF 152-164, the complete Defensive I/II/III Charm trees (21 Charms), pp. 161-167/PDF 164-170, the complete Survival and Healing I/II/III/IV Charm trees (22 Charms), pp. 168-174/PDF 171-177, the complete Perception I/II/III/IV Charm trees (25 Charms), pp. 174-181/PDF 177-184, the complete Stealth Charm tree (6 Charms), pp. 182-183/PDF 185-186, the complete Interaction and Knowledge I/II/III/IV Charm trees (26 Charms), pp. 183-191/PDF 186-194, and the complete Spirit and Sorcery-access Charms (9 Charms), pp. 191-193/PDF 194-196 -- completing every Charm category in Chapter Five. Backgrounds, Merits/Flaws, caste/tribe creation options (Chapter Four: Traits, pp. 94-115/PDF 97-118), and supplements, are not yet inventoried.

sources.role: Primary Lunar rules, Charms, Backgrounds, Merits/Flaws, and setting material

rulesNotes: Printed page numbers in this book run 3 less than the PDF page number supplied (PDF page = printed page + 3) for the copy used to build this inventory; both are recorded on every citation.
Lunar Charms use Minimum Attribute (not Minimum Ability) fields, per p. 122 (PDF 125).

A handful of rows in the Unarmed Combat III-V trees have book text that reads awkwardly around botch/infection resolution (Rabid Beast Bite, Grasping Pseudopod Method); paraphrased faithfully but flagged in each row's notes for a closer re-read before promotion. Armor-Rending Claw Fist's mechanics also cut off mid-sentence at the bottom of its rendered page and needs the following page reviewed to complete it.

Melee Combat I/II and Ranged Combat I/II are now complete (pp. 149-161/PDF 152-164). Several Charm descriptions span a page break in the source (stat block/tree diagram on one page, prose continuing on the next); these were transcribed as single continuous Charms with a note on the page split where applicable. Arrow-Shaping Method cross-references Shaping the Once-Living Form (an existing Shapechanging II Charm row) as a co-prerequisite alongside Nature's Harmony Advantage.

Defensive I/II/III are now complete (pp. 161-167/PDF 164-170). The Defensive-III tree diagram (PDF p. 169/printed p. 166) labels one node 'Limb-Shedding Growth', but the Charm's own header and running text (PDF p. 170/printed p. 167) both read 'Limb-Shielding Growth' -- the Charm's own text was trusted per the standing rule to prefer stated Charm text over tree-diagram lettering when they conflict. Pack-Saving Method references a reduced-cost case tied to a Charm named 'Brotherhood of Lake and River' not yet located elsewhere in this book; no crossReferences entry was added for it pending that Charm's discovery.

Survival and Healing I/II/III/IV are now complete (pp. 168-174/PDF 171-177). Unerring Den-Finding Sense's own Prerequisite Charms line lists only Beast Instinct Method even though the Survival and Healing II tree diagram draws it alongside Food-Scenting Method and Water-Providing Technique feeding into Wolf Endurance Method; the Charm's own text was trusted. Bruise-Relief Technique's cost/rate sentence reads redundantly in the source and is flagged in its notes for a closer look before promotion.

Perception I/II/III/IV are now complete (pp. 174-181/PDF 177-184). Heightened (Sense) Method is one three-part Charm (sight; hearing/touch; smell/taste) that the Perception II/III/IV tree diagrams draw as three differently-labeled root nodes; those labels were recorded as aliases on a single inventory row rather than as separate Charms. Ritual of Lunar Stability's stat block Duration (lunar months) and mechanics text (weeks) disagree on units for the same permanent-Essence-scaled figure; transcribed faithfully as printed and flagged in its notes.

Stealth (6 Charms, pp. 182-183/PDF 185-186) and Interaction and Knowledge I/II/III/IV (26 Charms, pp. 183-191/PDF 186-194) are now complete. Locating Pack-Forming Presence and Brotherhood of Lake and River in the Interaction and Knowledge III/IV trees closed out both previously-open co-prerequisite items on Sense-Borrowing Method and Pack-Saving Method; their crossReferences were updated and their notes removed. Several rows in this range flag illustration cut-offs or garbled/redundant source phrasing (Chameleon Skin Disguise, Lion Roar Method, Pack-Calling Cry) that were paraphrased as faithfully as legible but merit a second look before promotion.

Spirit Charms (4 Charms) and Sorcery-access Charms (5 Charms), pp. 191-193/PDF 194-196, are now complete, finishing every Charm category in Chapter Five. Next up: Backgrounds, Merits/Flaws, and caste/tribe character-creation options in Chapter Four: Traits, pp. 94-115/PDF 97-118 (Expanded/Altered Backgrounds include Artifact, Backing, Followers, Manse, Mentor, plus new Lunar-specific Backgrounds such as Cult, Heart's Blood, and Renown).
